scope: Initial shared ordinary-work admission wiring. No product updater/close/reopen route, hardware, daemon launch or native GUI run.
implementation: PersistenceStore-scoped Admission clones shared by IPC/services/manager. Atomic close vs enter; last worker/monitor child lease releases admitted group; dropping drain waiter never reopens.
69 root DaemonRpc methods admit; five known convenience delegates route through those guards. Owned preparation and returned theme/preview futures retain tracked capacity permits across caller loss.

Tracked pools: theme/assets/fonts/media/profiles/GC preparation, ArchiveTransfers, GroupExports, GroupUploads work/Finish/cancel, DisplaySettings, SystemSpec, finite media exports. Media composition retains the tracked preparation permit until its existing release boundary.

Owned group panic monitors and cleanup tasks inherit child lease; FinishSource explicitly moves its lease into blocking prepare. Reapers enroll actual cleanup iterations and stop new ones on seal; sleeping loop does not hold a lease.

Manager admission covers enumerate/diff/attach/replay and power transitions. Closed gate skips discovery and refuses ordinary sleep/wake; joined shutdown remains available. Existing keepers/HID must still be separately quiesced/joined.
Test-only blocking HID gate now releases on exit/panic and bounds fake write wait to10s; original assertions/timeouts retained. Added panic cleanup regression.

checks.native_gui: not run; no frontend/native app source change

coverage: Close/enter atomic race32times, child lease lifetime, cancelled drain waiter, blocked detached worker, capacity rejection without count leak.
Actual IPC preparation helper retains tracked permit after caller abort until owned work exits.
Real JSON-RPC memory server/client returns Busy on sealed gate; direct trait/storage paths refuse before effects. Mock discovery does not attach, power refused, shutdown joins.
Panic unwind releases a blocked mock HID writer before runtime teardown.

intermediate_run.state: A repeated workspace run stalled in manager sleep/wake fixture; confirmed private binary was terminated and run was not counted as passing.
intermediate_run.original_trigger: Not established; standalone diagnostic did not reproduce. Existing test-only gate had an unbounded blocking wait and lacked panic-release guard.
intermediate_run.follow_up: Hardened test cleanup, added panic-exit regression, reran manager8tests,32sleep/wake iterations and full workspace on final unchanged snapshot.

remaining: Publication::Drop and file/data async destructor cleanup outside shared lease lifecycle: explicit staging/publication close-and-join and idle transfer invalidation required.
Full drain/monitor/reaper/fault matrix and bounded cancellation policy. active0 proves only enrolled owners have ended; it cannot authorize product Apply.
Update-owner admission, checked keeper/HID quiescence and FIFO drain, fresh settings snapshot and asset pins, power/shutdown cancellation policy.
Coordinator original-handle transfer then joined teardown/probe, qualified durable guard/journal resolution including serial-less recovery and EN/RU UI.
Gate is process-local one-way; no automatic reopen or restart recovery replacement for durable journal/settings quarantine.
